# GateVerse

> GateVerse (جيت فيرس) is a professional 3D virtual tour service in Egypt, based in Alexandria. It scans apartments, villas and commercial spaces with professional 3D cameras and delivers an interactive tour, with room measurements, on a permanent shareable link within 48 hours of the shoot. Works on any phone, tablet or computer with no app.

GateVerse helps real estate agents, owners, developers and commercial landlords filter out non-serious viewings: buyers and renters walk through every room and measure spaces from their phone before visiting in person. The website is in Arabic (primary); service is available in Arabic and English.

## Pricing (Egyptian pounds)

Prices depend on the type of place, and the rate per m² falls as the area grows (each band of m² at its own rate):

- Real estate (apartments, villas): 20 EGP/m² up to 130 m², 15 EGP/m² from 131 to 200 m², 12 EGP/m² above 200 m²; minimum 1,000 EGP. Hosting 100 EGP per month per tour, or 500 EGP per month for 10 tours (10% off when paid yearly); the subscription moves to a new unit when one is sold or rented. Example: a 150 m² apartment costs 2,900 EGP shooting + 100 EGP per month.
- Commercial (wedding halls, gyms, spas, furniture showrooms, shops, kids areas, restaurants, cafés): 20 EGP/m² up to 150 m², 10 EGP/m² from 151 to 400 m², 6 EGP/m² above 400 m²; minimum 1,000 EGP. The first year of hosting is included; renewal 1,200 EGP per year. Example: an 800 m² hall costs 7,900 EGP.
- Hotels: 13 EGP/m² up to 1,000 m², 8 EGP/m² up to 3,000 m², 5 EGP/m² above (area = the spaces shot); minimum 5,000 EGP; first year of hosting included, then 10% of the shoot per year.
- Kitchens: 750 EGP per kitchen, 15% off each extra kitchen shot the same day; hosting per year: 250 EGP for one tour, 500 EGP for 10 tours, 1,200 EGP for 30 tours.
- Payment: cash, bank transfer, InstaPay

## What a tour includes

- Immersive 360° scan of the whole space (a "digital twin")
- Interactive room measurements inside the tour
- Clickable points of interest (materials, appliance brands, AC type, smart-home videos)
- A permanent link to share on WhatsApp and social media, plus an embed code (iframe) for any website or property portal

## How it works

1. Booking: send the property location and approximate area on WhatsApp to set an appointment
2. On-site scan: a GateVerse engineer scans the space (1–2 hours)
3. Processing: lighting, dimensions and the 3D model are prepared
4. Delivery: the tour link and embed code are delivered within 48 hours

## Who it is for

- Real estate agents and brokers listing properties
- Owners selling or renting apartments and villas
- Commercial space owners (offices, shops, clinics)
- Developers showcasing new projects

## Coverage

Alexandria, Egypt (31.2001, 29.9187), including Smouha, Montaza, Sidi Gaber, Agami, Borg El Arab, Cleopatra and Ibrahimia. Working hours: Sunday–Thursday, 09:00–18:00.

## FAQ

Q: How much does a virtual tour cost?
A: It depends on the type of place and its area, and the rate per m² falls as the area grows. A 150 m² apartment is 2,900 EGP once plus 100 EGP/month hosting; commercial spaces start at 1,000 EGP with the first year of hosting included; kitchens are 750 EGP each. The calculator at https://massah.tours/#pricing gives the exact price.

Q: How long does production take?
A: The finished tour link is delivered within 48 hours of the shoot.

Q: What technology is used?
A: Professional 3D scanning cameras that produce an interactive digital twin with accurate measurements.

Q: Does it work on mobile and on property websites?
A: Yes. It runs in the browser on all devices without an app, and can be embedded on any website or sent on WhatsApp.
